evidence.observation: Before fix: missing dashboard-first-window-noscroll.yml; count claim 41 vs live 42. After fix: check-links --workflow-inventory PASS; full check-links PASS.
Policy claimed 41 GitHub Actions workflows; live glob is 42.

findings.expected: Published inventory lists every live .github/workflows/*.yml and count equals live glob.
findings.impact: docs.yml validate-mkdocs unflagged check-links fails on the next docs-path PR; operators treat a stale 41-file catalog as current.
findings.root_cause: New PR/push workflow added without updating the published inventory; docs.yml path filters omit .github/workflows/**.
findings.remediation: Sync inventory/count (#9265). Follow-up: trigger docs.yml on workflow YAML changes (#9266).
